name: Maria Santos
psychographics: Prioritises organic and local; struggles to balance ethical spending with a tightening grocery budget each month.
current_solutions: Meal plans on Pinterest every Sunday; local butcher for meat; refill station for pantry staples.
frustration: Woke up at 7:05 AM, realized the school milk money app hadn't updated the payment, tried to pay via phone at 8:40 AM drop-off but the server was down, forcing me to write a cheque I don't have.
decision_style: Always asks other parents in the playground; trusts word-of-mouth over online ads completely.
voice: Rambling and thoughtful; often starts sentences with 'So, the thing is...' and loops back to the main point multiple times.
